title: AlgoTrace analyzer result v1
description: Result of the analyzer for one run, one JSON object per line of the series analysis file. Computed only from the run log (executed tool_call events) and the reference algorithms replayed on the same instance; read by the analysis.

calibration_id.description: Version of the frozen thresholds (protocol D06); null before calibration.

token_variant.description: Operation tokens used for distances: full = C(i,j)/S(i,j), type = C/S, relative = type + distance + result.

trace_length.description: Number of operation tokens: executed calls without done.

metrics.description: Measures of the run. The named ones are fixed for their task family; further numeric measures may be added.

redundant_compares.description: Comparisons whose result already followed by transitivity from earlier ones.

inversions.description: Inversions of the initial array (swaps of bubble and insertion sort).

min_swaps.description: N minus the number of cycles of the initial permutation.

recoveries_after_error.description: Errors followed by a valid call.

distances.description: Distance of the trace to every variant of every reference algorithm replayed on the same instance, closest first.

normalized_distance.description: distance / max(length of trace, length of reference).

kind.description: known = one reference below the threshold; hybrid = segments of different references; novel = none below the threshold; ambiguous = several references equally close; not_classified = too short or not analysable.

algorithm.description: The recognised reference for known; null otherwise.

margin.description: Normalized distance of the second closest reference minus the closest; null when there is only one.

segments.description: Segments of a hybrid (dynamic programming over segments); [] for other labels.

declaration.description: Announced algorithm (protocol D01): the text comes from the first model_turn, its label from the analysis, not from the run log.

declared_algorithm.description: Reference name, other (an algorithm without a reference) or null (nothing announced).

matches_label.description: declared_algorithm equals label.algorithm; null when either is missing.

algorithm.description: Name of a reference algorithm, e.g. bubble_sort, insertion_sort, selection_sort, quicksort, merge_sort, recursive_hanoi, binary_search, linear_search.
